about: Per-model META patch-data library - MEER Tool Pro (Round 7, B3). Security Plugin ki enrollment state META se pohanch wali proinfo/NVRAM-class storage me hoti hai (SEPT-SEC-RESEARCH section 4-B item 3); plugin OFF aur RESTORE MDM ka asal kaam yahi per-model byte data hai - protocol (FT) tool ke paas hai, data is library se ata hai.

lk_patch.note: Bootloader unlock ke LK patch ka data (B2).

patches.find_hex: asal bytes (hex) jo device par is offset par hone chahiye - match na hon to op ruk jata hai
patches.replace_hex: find ke barabar lambai ke naye bytes (hex)

lk_patch.source: data kahan se mila (apna bench tajurba / public source + tareekh) - lazmi hai

honesty_note: Is build me kisi model ka byte-pattern jaan-boojh kar NAHI rakha gaya: koi public source verified per-model patch pattern nahi deta, aur guessed offset par likhna phone brick kar sakta hai. 'models' khali hai - structure mukammal hai. Jis model ka data Hamza apne bench kaam se verify karke yahan jama karega, usi din se us model par ye ops asal chalenge; baqi par tool guided STOP dega, wajah ke saath. Restore ke liye alag data nahi chahiye - har patch se pehle tool asal bytes khud backup record me mehfooz karta hai.

kinds.lk_patch: META UBL (B2): LK backup -> patch -> unlock; restore = backup record se asal LK bytes wapas.
kinds.plugin_patch: META Security Plugin patch (B3); is ka jora Restore MDM (META) backup record se asal halat wapas karta hai.
kinds.anti_crack_capture: Anti-crack patch-data CAPTURE (Round 2, Group 5) - ye patch NAHI hai, sirf bench snapshot hai: proinfo/prodnv partitions META FT_PART_READ se parh kar save ki jati hain (read-only). Removal/patch apply is data se ALAG round me banega, jab snapshot compare karke asal patch region pehchana ja sake.
